notes.title: L.S.S II has been released!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1056330/LSS_II/

We have finally released L.S.S II in early access!

Hopefully the community enjoys this and that you will stick around till we finish it!

Unfortunately our team size has decreased and development is slower than usual but it won't stop us from creating our game :)

If you do find any bugs please let us know on the discussions section and we will get on it right away.

Finally, we hope that everyone has a good time playing and hopefully we will see you in game.

Note: Multiplayer is in a very early stage and we currently only allow 20 CCU but this will change in the future.  

[h1]Known Bugs[/h1]

- Barricades don't sync on the network about 90% of the time.
- Use text may get stuck on the screen but we believe it's fixed now.

tags.bug: - Barricades don't sync on the network about 90% of the time.
- Use text may get stuck on the screen but we believe it's fixed now.

notes.title: Big optimization update! + Upcoming updates
notes.content:
We have made massive improvements to levels to help get better fps and hopefully low end pc's can run this game.

Here is the patch notes:

- Fixed a bug that caused a perk to charge twice as much.
- Improved fps massively.
- Fixed the crosshair not showing on lower resolutions.
- Fixed some values not saving.

With the next couple of update we hope to achieve this:

- Port the game to mac and linux.
- Bring new infected types.
- Start season 3.
- Bring back nukesite classic.

notes.title: Massive update!
notes.content:
Hello!

It has been a very long time since our last update and we want to apologise for not updating the game and giving the content that we promised.

We will be doing a few updates over the coming days but they will be the final updates to this game as we want to go on to better projects that will make up for this mess of a game.

We will be changing the name of the game back to L.S.S as we want to go back to our roots with horror and LSD was all about colour and silliness but that did not work with this game.

This update contains:

[Added]

- New UI In game.
- New UI for menus.
- 2 new perks [Marathon & QuickDraw]
- Added secret to NukeSite.

[Changed or removed]

- Removed multiplayer.
- Removed mods (Will return soon).
- Removed Custom Skins (Will return soon).
- Removed Town map.
- Removed Tracers.
- Removed LSD effects.
- Changed brutes speed from 3.7 to 4.2.
- Changed Player movement.
- Changed Physics.

[Bugs]

- Alt tabbing and tabbing back in will not lock the mouse (Unity problem).
- Skins UI is not scaled properly.

Thanks to everyone that stuck around and kept playing, we hope our next game will change your mind about us!

tags.bug: - Alt tabbing and tabbing back in will not lock the mouse (Unity problem).
- Skins UI is not scaled properly.

notes.title: Hack and slash!
notes.content:
We have have added a new melee system that is still a work in progress but we are releasing it early for testing so we can get some feedback.

To use this new feature, just press the "C" key and you will swing your knife.

[Bugs : Minor]

- You can knife while using a perk.
- You can use the knife in the pause menu.
- You can use the knife while using a grenade.
- You can use the knife while dead.

[These will be fixed in the next update]

notes.title: We have left early access!
notes.content:
WE HAVE LEFT EARLY ACCESS!

We finally did it and we are very thankful to anyone that has stuck with us and seen this game become what it is now.

We will continue to update this game as we need to get multiplayer working still but as this game is out of the way it means we can get a better project in the works and hopefully won't be as generic as this one.

We have also joined along side "Funky Gorilla Games" to help them on their project called "Beyond Type 1: 2150 so make sure to look out for that when it hits steam!

Hopefully you all stick around to see us develop into a bigger and better indie studio!

- Spencer Fossett -

Discord: https://discord.gg/mnZp6fu

Anyway here is the patch notes

[Maps]

- Removed Tower.
- Removed the outside area on Cemetery.
- Added new props for Cemetery and NukeSite.

[Gameplay]

- Added ADS (Aim Down Sights)
- Tweaked weapons so they do more damage.
- Added injection for perks.

[UI]

- Added new menu.

[Multiplayer (Invite only for now)]

- Added kick feature.
- Fixed buying weapons.
- Fixed pause menu.
- Added muzzle flash.
- Added tracers.


[Modes]

- Added endless mode.
- Fixed mods not opening.
- Fixed mods adding score to the wrong leaderboard. 

[Known Bugs]

- Weapon box may show "Enjoy" when you do not get a weapon.
- ADS may get stuck (Rare)
- Menu UI may overlay other buttons etc.

notes.title: Big changes! (89.0 MB)
notes.content:
Hello its been about 10 days since our last update and we have been working on many things that would may like here is a list of things that are coming in this update.

[h1]Additions and changes[/h1]

- Added mods.
- Added new logo.
- Added new soundtrack to fit the new theme.
- Added Xmas event.
- Changed uzi and m249 animation.
- Tweaked some visual settings.
- Will edit if I forget anything -

[h1]Event[/h1]

Xmas event!

Our first event to be added to LSD and we hope you enjoy this one as its mostly just testing our new AI that is coming but also changing it up to be a bit silly.

You go against "Fake Santa" a mad man who thinks he owns xmas but we all know he doesn't as he looks nothing like Santa and will get laughed at if he even tries to say he is.
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/b106010cd8a78cf81566da21f7b6658678a6a9f0.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/78fdc74a5e734e390439dd53fa915a63e24d52a2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Mods[/h1]

We are adding modding as we think that you should be able to make your own game mode but currently you are very limited as we are still working on it but to make a mod go to this menu,[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/01fd04ed4747fcfc08617a04ac9a1e4bfee6bf22.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/3378e5d5cd50a40e1e5151571245bbbde5dabf4d.jpg[/img][/url]

Once you are on the menu tweak the settings to what you want and choose a name and once all that is done click save mod and look in the mods section, if you do not see your mod then click refresh and it should appear. 

[h1]Bugs[/h1]

There are a few bugs that we have found and are working on now here is a list of bugs that we found,

- Uzi animation not synced up with sound.
- Version still says 0.4.0 (should be 0.5.0)
- Mods have some issues where it could default a setting.
- Will edit if I find more - 

[h1]Coming soon[/h1]

Tournament mode is coming soon to see who is the best and who can gain the rewards to show off they are the best!

Story mode is coming as well but in the survival form that the community wanted so been on the look out for that.

notes.title: Welcome to LSD (151.3 mb)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/514bef9dda5e1cd408a26383aa6844a482d3a553.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone, I am glad to announce that we are no longer going to call this game L.S.S, we are changing it to LSD.

[b] [u] Why LSD? [/u] [/b]

One of the reasons why is that most new players came to me and said "what does L.S.S stand for?"
and most people don't understand as if you never played our other game called "Infection" you will not know that its the name of the virus in that game.

So changing it to LSD will make a lot more people understand what the game is kind of about, but it will still be the same game just with some "other" features. (Thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198259812257] BigCorporation [/url] for suggesting this idea)

[b] [u] What have we changed/added? [/u] [/b]

Here is a list of things we changed + added,

- Logo is now colourful.
- Players screen will change colour when hit by a trap, explosive or infected.
- Added Tower map. (Click the image to view)
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/ad92ccdc8e2fc6d52d1029620fb689e866f713b1.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/2d59fdb5dd20b92138e9144c3bd902938b4b90c9.jpg[/img][/url]
- Limbs can now be shot off.
- Added prestige mode. (Unlocked at lvl 70)
- Added season rewards.
- Added ranking.
- Added new weapon "G36C"
- Added Event skin.
- If I missed anything I will edit this post -


As we have added new features that also means there are some hidden bugs that we need to find so there will be a few hotfixes coming out over the past
few days, if you find a bug or exploit please let us know on the forums.

[b] [u] Ranking [/u] [/b]

Ranking has made a comeback to this game and we have set some goals for you to achieve!

Your season stats will reset every season but your round score will be saved to the leaderboards. 

To gain a rank you need to hit these thresholds,

[code]
Note: Kill requirements are lifetime kills
Note2: You can only gain a rank from playing nukesite! 
[/code]

[table]

[tr]
[th]Rank[/th]
[th]Kill requirement[/th]
[th]Round requirement[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
 [td]Bronze[/td]
 [td]100[/td]
 [td]5[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
 [td]Silver[/td]
 [td]200[/td]
 [td]10[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
 [td]Gold[/td]
 [td]300[/td]
 [td]15[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
 [td]Platinum[/td]
 [td]500[/td]
 [td]25[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
 [td]Diamond[/td]
 [td]750[/td]
 [td]50[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
 [td]Master[/td]
 [td]1000[/td]
 [td]75[/td]
[/tr]

[/table]

[b] [u] Appreciation [/u] [/b]

As always we can't thank you enough for playing our game and helping us build a better game <3

notes.title: Season 2 final update coming soon!
notes.content:
We are nearly at the end of testing season 2, and we want to thank everyone that participated in this season and helping us build a better game.

We have made some changes to what you are going to see this season and here they are.

- Added prestige mode once you reach level 100.
- Added rewards for prestige mode.
- Added season rewards.
- Added new rank "Master"

***** Will update list if needed *****

This update is going to take sometime as we want to get the right rewards and rank balance etc.


Note: Nukesite is the only map that will let you gain a rank. 
You can gain this rank now! as soon as the update goes live it will apply your rank.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/dafceef8ff9e86d88e27a4bb026fba143b4d6f48.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The future of L.S.S [Maps]
notes.content:
We have been thinking about the future of L.S.S and we think that we should show what we want to try and add into this game.

Here is a list of some of the things that we might add (maps wise),

[Maps]
- Classic nukesite (GameJolt Version) -
The map that the gamejolt community got to play on before we moved to steam.
This map is similar to the current nukesite but with less rooms and space to move in. 
----------------------------------------------------
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/fb63d5e606d9a4c9250c46d08b902a088d165c70.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/8a2899ccc60ecf85b1c4fff858e4b0155f23b5e1.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/60a1ac8522e6362208f2f356c4bff01794424ed4.jpg[/img]

- Tower (First ever map) -
This is the first ever map we made for L.S.S but we never finished it as we wanted to make nukesite.
We really want to bring this back as it was really fun go in the lift and go down to the bottom floor and fight on the catwalk.
----------------------------------------------------

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/90c56da5a7ad0d795a529d586526da5e1dfd4dc7.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/85bf51a958c3935a48d6c595e49c241845aeaa5e.jpg[/img]

- Church (New map coming soon) -
This one we really want to get done as its so much better than nukesite (From a design stand point) and it shows off our visuals and new npc models.
----------------------------------------------------
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/312494d0c836ae5bc1bba8b9affe5f16304c2769.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 0.2.5 is now live for testing! (41.7 mb)
notes.content:
We have put the update up for testing so we can get it perfect for when it goes to 0.3.0.

Here is what we changed,

- Added New weapons (Mac10, RPG and lee enfield)
- Changed damage on all weapons.
- Added new perk "Resurrection"
- Changed spawns for infected in early game so its much quicker.
- Added top 10 players from last season.
- Added new leaderboard.
- Added Rank badge.
- Added skip intro button.
- Added new infected type "Explosive"
- Added screen shake to know you have taken damage.
- Massive fps improvements. 

And much more!

If you find any bugs please let us know!

Thank you all for playing and we hope you enjoy this new update

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525349/bc200938e8753df4fe2a8dc04193019931797c8f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Big changes! (38.6 mb)
notes.content:
This is going to be a big change for L.S.S and here is what is in this update,

- Removed seasons.
- Added profile ranks.
- Added rewards from season 1.
- Changed reward cash from hitting infected from 10 to 5.
- Changed kill cash reward from 60 to 35.
- When you are hit by any infected your speed will be reduced for a little while.
- Reduced bounce on grenades.
- Reduced amount of exp given for skill points.
- Reduced amount of starting skill points.

Once again thank you all for playing and one other thing is, the weapons update should be next and with that update we will be resetting the leaderboards but don't worry your score will be added in game.

Nightmare mode!
This event will be live soon we are just adding the last things to it.
More info soon.

notes.title: Final changes for season one (28.1 mb)
notes.content:
The support for this game has been insane and we can't thank you enough <3

This update will contain the following:

- Changes to the catwalk area on nukesite.
- Added fall damage to make it hard to get away from the infected.
- Added view map option, press "m" to view. (Look below for example) 
- Added a sound and a notification when a round is starting.

Things we are currently working on:

- Weapons update.
- New rewards system.
- New customise menu.
- Better AI.
- Better optimization.

Once again thank you for your support!

This will be the final update for season one.

notes.title: Info on "Weapons update"
notes.content:
We are working on the weapons update as this post goes up and what this update is going to be is the following;

All weapons will be tweak, changing their damage, rate of fire, spread and reload speed.

There will be some new weapons to change gameplay as they are never seen before weapons in L.S.S (Pre steam version)

As there is not much to show at the moment we will leave you with this image :)

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/DKFSkBlW4AAr2Qf.jpg

notes.title: Hotfix 2 19/09/17 (7.4 MB)
notes.content:
Just small update that fixes the following,

- Fixed leaderboards not updating when you beat your high score.
- Fixed the leaderboards button and it should now display global leaderboards.

Congrats to  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198073284873] Sten Braah [/url] for reaching round 37!

Thank you to everyone who has played!

notes.title: Leaderboards update (31.2 mb)
notes.content:
We have finally got the leaderboards to work now!

When you beat your highest round it will automatically upload your score to the leaderboards.

This is still a work in progress and may not let you view it but we are going to be working on a few more things for leaderboards and stats.

There will be a weapons update soon so keep a look out for that update!
